scope: Prepared immutable Keychain vault plus two-process smoke test; app source/verification registration only, no live native flow or HTTP endpoint.
custody: Exact canonical accountID/epochID/submissionID only, synchronizable=false, requested WhenUnlockedThisDeviceOnly. Save requires exact readback; same-nonce foreign scope rejected. References filtered by account AND epoch; unknown references are retained, no automatic renewal or logout cleanup. Explicit removal affects only a matching local reference, never cancels a remote request.
capacity: At most32 records in ordinary serialized app use; admission check fails closed on unavailable/overfull inventory. This is not a cross-process atomic quota. No automatic oldest-record purge.
